scripts.build: pnpm --filter @geo-rs/core build && pnpm --filter @geo-rs/vue build && pnpm --filter @geo-rs/site build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @geo-rs/core build && pnpm --filter @geo-rs/vue build && pnpm -r typecheck
scripts.test:browser: pnpm --filter @geo-rs/core build && pnpm --filter @geo-rs/vue build && pnpm --filter @geo-rs/site build:browser && playwright test
scripts.test:package: pnpm --filter @geo-rs/core build && pnpm --filter @geo-rs/vue build && pnpm package:prepare && playwright test --config playwright.package.config.mjs
